address: The Lana, Marasi Drive, Business Bay, Dubai
bio: Be transported to the iconic French Riviera in the heart of Business Bay. Ideally located on the fourth floor of The Lana hotel, overlooking a small marina of luxury yachts, this restaurant exudes chic, French allure from its style to its flavours. Ratatouille cake, signature tuna tartare (made at your table) to green risotto and Carabineros spaghetti, allow you to travel from the South of France to Italy in just a few bites. Its bright terrace is perfect for alfresco dining during cooler weather....
